high_level_description: The image depicts an open book with aged, yellowed pages, suggesting it is an ancient or mystical artifact. The text on the pages reads: "We've been watching you delve these dread ruins. You have proven yourself a slayer of evils as they arise--but there are those of us who would stop them forever. Seek the arena to the north. Steel yourself against the screams and sounds of war, and you may find a destiny that suits you better." The background is dark and somewhat blurred, giving the impression of a dimly lit room or cave.
